high_level_description: The image shows a person standing indoors, facing away from the camera, wearing a white dress with an intricate lace-up back design. The dress features a strapless top and a fitted silhouette that extends to the knees. The person has long, dark hair that falls over their shoulders. The setting appears to be a modern, well-lit room with a minimalist design. There is a large mirror on the wall behind the person, reflecting part of the room, which includes a wooden cabinet with a geometric pattern. The lighting is warm, creating a cozy atmosphere.
